Retained for provenance.

Statistic-anchored pretraining (scripts/pretrain_sas.py), 120,000-window six-sample pretraining corpus. The encoder predicts the twelve alignment summary statistics of the unoccluded window from two occluded views instead of reconstructing masked pixels. One independent seed each. feat_mean/feat_var are the pretraining-stream normaliser statistics and must be used as stored, not recomputed downstream.
